sn22.153:1.2: Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati ||
sn22.153:1.3: No cassaṃ no ca me siyā na bhavissāmi na me bhavissatī ti || || 3
sn22.153:1.5: Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpam upādāya rūpam abhinivissa evam diṭṭhi uppajjati ||
sn22.153:1.6: No cassaṃ no ca me siyā na bhavissāmi na me bhavissatīti || || 5-7
sn22.153:1.10: Viññāṇe sati viññāṇam upādāya viññāṇam abhinivissa evam diṭṭhi uppajjati ||
sn22.153:1.11: No cassaṃ no ca me siyā na bhavissāmi na me bhavissatī ti || || 9
sn22.153:1.13: Rūpaṃ niccam vā aniccam vā ti || ||
sn22.153:1.15: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.153:1.17: Yam panāniccam dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammam api nu tam anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya || ||
sn22.153:1.18: No cassaṃ no me siyā na bhavissāmi na me bhavissatī ti || ||
sn22.153:1.23: Viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn22.153:1.28: No cassaṃ no ca me siyā na bhavissāmi na me bhavissatīti || ||
